# 1. Executive pulse
Primary signal is the **MCP 2026-07-28 specification** (released ~July 28, actively discussed and adopted in-window): full shift to stateless, self-contained requests (no initialize handshake or session IDs). Enables serverless/round-robin scaling, header-based routing (`Mcp-Method`/`Mcp-Name`), Multi Round-Trip Requests (MRTR), cacheable lists, auth hardening, and extensions framework. Ecosystem (Cloudflare Agents SDK, .NET SDK v2, Firecrawl MCP, proxies) already shipping support or dual-mode.[1](https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28/)

Secondary: Claude Code skills maturation (incl. reported `/btw` aside skill; bundled `/run`/`/verify`/`code-review`); GitHub Copilot GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra price cuts (80%/20%); Firecrawl MCP@3.23.0 context reduction (~50%) + OAuth/keyless. Low volume on pure design/AEO/consumer taste in the ~30h window; agent production readiness and context-cost discipline dominate.[2](https://x.com/github/status/2083261791363363273)

Evidence quality high for MCP (official blog + multiple implementer posts); lower for ephemeral skills/claims. Uncertainty: exact `/btw` docs not fully surfaced in primary sources; adoption friction for breaking changes acknowledged.

# 2. High-signal findings
**MCP stateless core (highest signal)**  
- No sessions: every request carries protocol version, client info, capabilities in `_meta`. Any replica handles any request.  
- Headers for routing/throttling without body parse.  
- MRTR for mid-tool user input without long-lived streams.  
- Cacheable `tools/list` etc. (`ttlMs` + `cacheScope`).  
- Auth: RFC 9207 issuer validation, DCR deprecated toward CIMD, binding.  
- Tasks → official extension; 12-month deprecation.  
- SDKs Tier-1 updated; Cloudflare `agents@latest` day-zero + migration; C# v2.0; community proxies dual-mode.[1](https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28/)[3](https://x.com/ritakozlov/status/2083226344205246945)  
Observed: production guides (AAIF/Steve Kearns) stress app-level state via explicit handles (not transport), tool minimization (GitHub anecdote: 40-tool schema +10-15KB/turn; irrelevant tool 58% of calls).[4](https://x.com/openmartbot/status/2083357597814718809)

**Tooling updates**  
- Firecrawl MCP 3.23.0: ~50% less context on search/scrape/interact; OAuth humans + keyless agents.[5](https://x.com/MaxITfinds/status/2083364200059936913)  
- Claude Code: skills as first-class (SKILL.md, dynamic injection, subagents, nested monorepo); bundled verification/run skills; reported new `/btw` for non-resetting asides mid-task.[6](https://x.com/alliekmillewyhf/status/2083455268952969483)[7](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills)  
- GitHub Copilot: GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna GA earlier; Luna -80%, Terra -20% pricing effective ~July 30 (credits).[2](https://x.com/github/status/2083261791363363273)  
- AgentsRoom v1.125: per-step/per-agent reasoning effort pinning.  
- Misc: 1Password Environments + MCP (secrets critique: if app can access, agent can); Unity CLI + MCP; various skill repos (session repair, book-to-video).

**Other**  
- Agent PR volume (GitHub: 17M in March 2026); single-agent long-running loops with state files + auto-merge checklists.  
- Security: Agent Egress Lab (Playwright offline E2E + allowlist proxy) for prompt-injection/egress control.  
- Frontend workflows: multi-tool (Codex + design refs + Stitch variants) to escape generic AI aesthetics; Google ADK/A2UI notes on locked backends + controlled UIs.

No major new Cursor/Copilot plugins or evaluation harnesses in window. Conflicting: some claim skills > MCP for token efficiency; others emphasize MCP production scaling.

# 3. Consumer taste and demographic signals
Sparse direct signals in window (short period + search focus).  
Observed:  
- Creator emphasis on short-form realism/details, modest settings for weight, structural outlier analysis (YouTube niches via MCP tools) over averages.  
- Broader (contextual): AI multiplies CS fundamentals (Andrew Ng hierarchy: fundamentals + AI fluency > pure experience or pure prompting). UI/UX learning rising as abstraction layer.  
- Buying language: practical “agent OS in 4 days” (memory + project + skill + schedule); PaaS for indie ($3/mo real server, MCP-native deploy/logs/db).  

Inference (low confidence): local-service and maker audiences value deterministic, low-cold-start, agent-operable tooling and non-generic visuals. No strong demographic/cultural shifts isolated to period. Watch creator discovery (Nexlev-style MCP research) and anti-AI-slop design language.

# 4. Agent, MCP, skill, GitHub, and workflow opportunities
- **Stateless MCP migration**: dual-support proxies/SDKs already exist; enables Dillon OS serverless MCP hosts, better load-balancing, lower ops. Header routing for gateways. Explicit handles for any needed state. Classify: sandbox-test for stack compatibility.  
- **Firecrawl MCP update**: lower context cost for research/scrape in site factory or prospecting. Keyless agent path.  
- **Claude Code skills**: `/btw`, `/run`+`/verify` (app launch + behavioral check, not just tests), custom SKILL.md with dynamic `!command` injection, monorepo nested, plugin marketplace. Parallel: reasoning-effort pinning (AgentsRoom pattern). Overlap with existing orchestration low if focused on verification loops.  
- **Copilot GPT-5.6 pricing**: cheaper Luna/Terra for volume coding/parallel agents.  
- **Production patterns**: tool-count discipline, observability before multi-agent, egress allowlists + offline Playwright, state-file + retrospective + auto-merge checklists for long-running agents.  
- **Workflow**: supervisory loops with per-step model/effort; multi-agent handoff for UI variants + SEO audit.  

Assessment axes (all candidates): source = official/maintainer high; freshness high; maintenance (spec has 12mo policy); stack compat (HTTP/JSON-RPC, npm/etc.); permissions/secrets (auth hardening good, but 1Password critique stands—app access = agent access); prompt-injection (egress labs relevant); context cost (Firecrawl win, tool bloat loss); $ cost (pricing cuts positive); rollback (dual-mode/SDKs); acceptance = deterministic (e.g., request without session succeeds on any replica; context size delta; `/verify` catches visual/functional regressions).

No install/connect during research.

# 5. Website factory, design, AEO, and retention implications
- **Factory (25-site)**: Stateless MCP + lower-context Firecrawl improve research/real-imagery pipelines and Maps-to-site parity checks. Maker-checker via `/verify`-style skills + independent visual critique (multi-variant + human gate). Offline Playwright + egress for safe QA. AEO trust gates: cacheable tool lists + explicit auth reduce hallucination surface; source-ready FAQs via structured skills. Preview/Netlify: serverless MCP friendly.  
- **Design/UI/UX**: Multi-tool workflows (design refs + motion + variants) explicitly to avoid generic AI look. Tokens/systems still human-curated; AI for generation + iteration under constraints. Accessibility/performance testing via agent + Playwright. Figma-to-code remains handoff-heavy.  
- **AEO/GEO/SEO/retention**: Limited fresh claims. AI Overviews/Mode still favor structured, citable, experience-backed content. Local/GBP parity via scrape+verify loops. CRO/landing: deterministic acceptance (visual regression + a11y + perf gates). Third-visit/retention: clearer onboarding via skills; offers tied to real outcomes. Analytics: agent PR volume implies attribution challenges for AI-assisted work.  
- **Operational**: Vertical templates + real imagery prioritized; approval gates before deploy. Context-engineering (minimize tools, cache lists) directly cuts factory cost.

Inference: factory throughput gains from stateless + verification skills; design differentiation via anti-slop process.

# 6. Recommended experiments ranked by expected benefit, evidence strength, risk, deterministic acceptance test, independent checker, and rollback
1. **Sandbox-test MCP 2026-07-28 dual-mode client/server** (highest benefit: scalability for any agent tooling). Evidence: official + multi-vendor. Risk: medium (breaking, migration). Acceptance: request without session ID succeeds round-robin; MRTR input flow works; old 1.x path byte-identical. Checker: separate process or Cloudflare Workers replica. Rollback: pin old SDK/spec. Human gate: yes (compat matrix).  
2. **Sandbox-test Firecrawl MCP@3.23.0 context delta** on site-research tasks. Evidence: maintainer post. Risk: low. Acceptance: measured token/context reduction ≥40% on identical scrape/search; keyless auth works; output parity. Checker: side-by-side old vs new. Rollback: version pin.  
3. **Sandbox-test Claude Code `/verify` + custom run-skill + `/btw`** for factory component/QA loops. Evidence: docs + reports. Risk: low-medium (version-specific). Acceptance: launches app, confirms behavioral change (not just unit), mid-task aside without reset; records recipe. Checker: independent browser/Playwright run. Rollback: disable skill.  
4. **Save-to-library production MCP guide patterns** (tool minimization, explicit handles, observability, egress). Evidence: AAIF. Risk: none.  
5. **Watch AgentsRoom-style effort pinning + long-running state-file agent loops**.  

Prefer these testable few over broad installs. No production, no credentials, no outreach.

# 7. Watchlist and rejected hype
**Watchlist**  
- Full ecosystem migration timelines and remaining sticky-session edge cases.  
- Claude skills marketplace growth and `/btw` official docs.  
- GPT-5.6 credit consumption in Copilot real workloads.  
- Agent Egress Lab / similar injection defenses.  
- Anti-generic-AI frontend multi-tool recipes.  
- Nexlev-style research MCPs for creator/vertical discovery.  
- KamuiDash or similar MCP-native PaaS pricing/ops.

**No action / Rejected hype**  
- Viral “agent OS in 4 days” or single-prompt OS/Doom claims without reproducible harness.  
- Broad 40+ tool MCP servers (context bloat + mis-invocation evidence).  
- 1Password Environments as complete secret solution (access equivalence critique).  
- Unverified skill repos or low-engagement “new plugin” claims without source/repro.  
- Duplicated capabilities already in stack (generic orchestration, basic scrape).  
- Any tool requiring production secrets, persistent elevated perms, or non-rollbackable install.  
- Aggregate PR volume stats without quality/ determinism filters.

## What Dillon OS should change today
1. Prioritize sandbox dual-mode MCP 2026-07-28 support (stateless path first) for all internal servers/clients — unlocks serverless factory agents.  
2. Measure and adopt Firecrawl MCP 3.23+ for research steps (context win).  
3. Prototype Claude Code `/verify` + recipe recording as maker-checker gate in site factory (behavioral, not just lint).  
4. Enforce tool-minimization + explicit-handle state in any new MCP (per AAIF/GitHub data).  
5. Add offline Playwright + egress allowlist pattern to QA checklist.  

(No installs, no deploys, no spend.)
